text.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun specifying the prior good-doers through the conduct that follows
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) resumes the prior reward category rather than starting a detached group. Its relative form turns identity into definition by conduct: the people in view are recognized through what the following verb says they keep avoiding. The boundary with 53:31 stays open, so this word helps complete who receives the excellent recompense.

topics.headline: relative handoff from prior ayah
topics.summary: The relative pronoun keeps 53:32 tied to the reward frame of 53:31 and defines the group by the following conduct.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by specifying the prior good-doers, not by introducing a new moral audience.
topics.reason: QAC allows apposition, description, or new-subject analysis, but all surviving rows keep the pronoun referentially tied to the preceding good-doers.

words.gloss_range: ongoing deliberate avoidance, with Form VIII self-distancing governing the moral list
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on j-n-b as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:يَجْتَنِبُونَ}} ({{tr:yajtanibūna}}) presents avoidance as a continuing habit, not a single completed act. {{ar:ج ن ب}} ({{tr:j-n-b}}) contributes a side/flank image: the wrongs are kept off to the side of the self. Form VIII makes the distancing deliberate and self-involving, and the same avoidance construction is recognizable in 4:31 and 42:37 before the ayah closes with another Form VIII guarding verb.

topics.headline: habitual self-distancing
topics.summary: The imperfect Form VIII verb defines the group by ongoing, deliberate avoidance of the listed categories.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees moral excellence as disciplined self-distancing from grave wrongs, framed by a recurring Quranic avoidance formula.
topics.reason: The imperfect indicative, Form VIII morphology, and object list support habitual self-directed avoidance; parallels at 4:31 and 42:37 are comparative support rather than replacement of the local parse.

words.gloss_range: major wrongs as a plural magnitude-class directly governed by the avoidance verb
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on k-b-r as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:كَبَٰٓئِرَ}} ({{tr:kabāʾira}}) receives the force of the avoidance verb as its first object. {{ar:ك ب ر}} ({{tr:k-b-r}}) makes scale the classifier: the wording is about major instances within sin, not about naming a closed inventory of acts. The plural surface treats grave wrongs as a class, while the singular variant keeps visible how exception scope could be weighed differently; the same root also reverses polarity from greatest signs in 53:18 to great sins here.

topics.headline: magnitude-class of wrongs
topics.summary: The accusative plural names major sins by scale and creates an exception-scope pressure with the later minor-lapse term.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first avoided category is organized by magnitude, so the later exception must be measured against a gravity scale.
topics.reason: QAC confirms direct-object accusative and plural form; variant evidence is useful for scope contrast but does not override the canonical plural.

words.gloss_range: definite sin-domain completing the construct phrase major sins of sin
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on ʾ-th-m as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْإِثْمِ}} ({{tr:al-ithmi}}) makes culpability a known domain inside the construct phrase. {{ar:أ ث م}} ({{tr:ʾ-th-m}}) carries guilt and moral drag, so the major category is not only large but accountable and impeding. The construct can feel both descriptive and partitive, which is why the later exception becomes a real scope question rather than a decorative aside.

topics.headline: definite culpability domain
topics.summary: The genitive definite noun completes the construct and frames the avoided major wrongs as major instances within sin.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that magnitude is measured inside the definite domain of culpability, making the first object more precise than a generic list of bad acts.
topics.reason: QAC confirms the genitive construct role; semantic rows about culpability and drag are locally compatible with the direct object phrase.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle preserving two distinct avoided categories under one verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the second moral category under the same avoidance verb while preventing it from collapsing into the first. The conjunction makes scale and excess adjacent but distinct axes of wrongness. Its attached sound also lets the governed list continue without sounding like a fresh sentence.

topics.headline: coordination of distinct axes
topics.summary: The conjunction joins the second object to the first under the same avoidance predicate while preserving distinction.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah coordinates two kinds of avoided wrongs rather than restating one label twice.
topics.reason: QAC identifies coordination, and the row evidence supports a governed list rather than an appositive or new clause.

words.gloss_range: recognized class of gross excesses coordinated with major sins
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on f-ḥ-sh as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ}} ({{tr:al-fawāḥisha}}) is the second accusative object under the avoidance verb. {{ar:ف ح ش}} ({{tr:f-ḥ-sh}}) centers excess beyond proper bounds, so the word should not be narrowed to only one modern register; it names a known plural class of boundary-breaking wrongs. Coordinated with the magnitude word, it gives the moral list two axes: scale and excess.

topics.headline: boundary-excess category
topics.summary: The definite plural adds a recognized category of gross excess under the same avoidance regime.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second avoided category is about boundary-excess, complementing but not duplicating major sins.
topics.reason: QAC confirms accusative coordination; V4 and contextual evidence support an excess/boundary field broader than a single subtype.

words.gloss_range: exception particle creating the central scope crux between major wrongs and minor lapse
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) interrupts the avoidance list and makes the ayah ask how the next category relates to what preceded it. On a connected reading, the following term is carved from the moral field; on a disconnected reading, it is treated as a different category. Either way, the particle opens the question that the declaration of vast forgiveness immediately answers.

topics.headline: exception-scope hinge
topics.summary: The exception particle creates the ayah’s central interpretive crux and links the avoidance list to the forgiveness declaration.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a small particle determines whether minor lapse is an excluded subtype or a separate category answered by forgiveness.
topics.reason: Grammar rows explicitly preserve connected and disconnected exception possibilities; neither is contradicted by the local QAC role.

words.gloss_range: definite minor-lapse term with light-contact and near-contact pressure
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on l-m-m as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّمَمَ}} ({{tr:al-lamam}}) is the grammatical target of the exception. {{ar:ل م م}} ({{tr:l-m-m}}) contributes brushing, nearing, or brief contact, so the lapse is imagined as contact with fault without the same scale as major transgression. Its rarity makes the word carry unusual weight, and its later link to self-language explains why the ayah can admit minor fault while forbidding self-certification.

topics.headline: minor-contact exception
topics.summary: The rare definite noun names the exception as a known category of light contact with fault.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception is not generic weakness but a specialized minor-contact category that calls for vast covering forgiveness.
topics.reason: QAC confirms accusative exception status; semantic and rarity rows make the light-contact payoff locally valuable without turning it into major sin.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the divine answer to the exception
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) begins a confirmed nominal statement after the exception. It does not merely continue the list; it stabilizes the divine forgiveness declaration as the answer to the minor-lapse problem. The discourse pivots from human avoidance to what the Lord is like.

topics.headline: emphatic forgiveness answer
topics.summary: The particle marks the following divine attribute as the confirmed response to the exception.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the forgiveness clause as an asserted answer to the exception, not as a loose comment.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the annulment particle introducing an emphatic nominal clause, matching the discourse-pivot rows.

words.gloss_range: addressed Lord-name anchoring forgiveness, knowledge, and origin in one relation
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on r-b-b as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) routes the declaration through direct address: the Lord is named with a second-person singular suffix before forgiveness is described. {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) keeps lordship tied to nurture, completion, and origination, so the one vast in forgiveness is also the one who brings beings from origin to maturity. Same-surah links with guidance in 53:23 and final return in 53:42 make this Lord-name a spine of the argument.

topics.headline: addressed Lordship pivot
topics.summary: The possessed Lord-name shifts the ayah from human conduct to divine forgiveness, origin, and knowledge.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forgiveness is not an abstract attribute but belongs to the addressed Lord who also knows and originates the audience.
topics.reason: QAC confirms the possessed noun as the subject of the emphatic clause; contextual rows support the direct-address and same-surah Lordship frame.

words.gloss_range: active participle of spacious capacity bound to forgiveness by construct
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on w-s-ʿ as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:وَٰسِعُ}} ({{tr:wāsiʿu}}) functions as a stable predicate, presenting breadth as an enduring attribute rather than a one-time act. {{ar:و س ع}} ({{tr:w-s-ʿ}}) means capacity to encompass, and the construct binds that breadth specifically to forgiveness. After the minor-lapse exception, the word gives forgiveness enough room to contain what the moral list has just complicated.

topics.headline: spacious forgiveness capacity
topics.summary: The active participle makes divine breadth a standing capacity focused by the following forgiveness noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forgiveness is described as spacious capacity capable of answering the minor-lapse exception.
topics.reason: QAC confirms active participle predicate and construct relation; semantic evidence supports capacity rather than bare size.

words.gloss_range: definite covering-forgiveness domain that closes the divine-attribute beat
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on gh-f-r as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-maghfirati}}) names the domain in which divine vastness operates. {{ar:غ ف ر}} ({{tr:gh-f-r}}) supplies protective covering rather than simple deletion, so the word answers how minor fault can be covered without erasing the difference between grave sins and lesser contact. Its closing position lets forgiveness absorb the first beat before origin-knowledge begins.

topics.headline: covering-forgiveness domain
topics.summary: The definite verbal noun completes the construct and makes vastness operate in the domain of covering forgiveness.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah answers minor lapse with a known domain of protective covering, not with denial that lapse occurred.
topics.reason: QAC confirms genitive construct role; V4 root imagery and discourse rows support covering-forgiveness as the local payoff.

words.gloss_range: independent divine pronoun restarting the subject for a knowledge claim
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) restarts the divine subject after the forgiveness clause. The pronoun prevents the knowledge statement from dissolving into the prior attribute and makes a new standing assertion: the Lord is the supreme knower about the addressees. Its repetition later brackets the prohibition with divine subjecthood.

topics.headline: divine subject restart
topics.summary: The independent pronoun opens the first knowledge clause and helps frame the later command.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a fresh divine-subject assertion beginning the knowledge proof that will ground the prohibition.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an independent subject pronoun, and discourse rows show it launching a nominal knowledge assertion.

words.gloss_range: elative knowledge predicate ranking divine knowledge above all rival self-knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on ʿ-l-m as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:aʿlamu}}) is an elative predicate, so the claim is not merely that God knows but that no competing knower outranks Him. {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) participates in the surah’s knowledge cluster, and the repeated cadence returns at the end with a different complement. This first occurrence grounds the coming command in knowledge of the addressees before birth.

topics.headline: supreme knowledge frame
topics.summary: The elative form asserts unmatched divine knowledge and begins the repeated knowledge frame around the command.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibition against self-certification is framed by ranked divine knowledge, not by ordinary advice.
topics.reason: QAC confirms elative predicate function; repeated-clause rows support the framing payoff.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the addressees as the aboutness-domain of divine knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the knowledge relation one of concern or aboutness. It keeps the following pronoun from being a bare direct object and turns the addressees into the domain under assessment. The immediate placement after the elative focuses the proof before the origin clauses explain it.

topics.headline: aboutness complement
topics.summary: The preposition attaches the audience to the elative as the domain of divine knowledge.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge is directed concerning the audience themselves, not only concerning isolated deeds.
topics.reason: QAC confirms the prepositional complement of the cognition elative; the rows support concerned-about relation.

words.gloss_range: attached plural audience pronoun known, originated, gestated, and commanded
words.prose: {{ar:كُمْ}} ({{tr:kum}}) makes the addressed plural community the object-domain of divine knowledge. The same plural address continues through origination, maternal origin, and the prohibition, so the hearers cannot keep the argument abstract. They are the ones known before they can certify themselves.

topics.headline: addressed audience thread
topics.summary: The attached pronoun starts the second-person plural chain that carries through the rest of the ayah.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the direct-address thread tying the audience to knowledge, origin, womb history, and the later command.
topics.reason: QAC confirms the attached genitive pronoun after the preposition; discourse rows trace the same audience through later suffixes.

words.gloss_range: past temporal anchor grounding divine knowledge in actual origin
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) anchors the knowledge claim in a real past moment, not a hypothetical condition. It carries both temporal and causal pressure: when God originated the addressees is also why His knowledge outranks self-report. As the first of two matched time anchors, it begins the origin proof.

topics.headline: first origin-time anchor
topics.summary: The first temporal adverb begins a two-part origin chronology supporting the knowledge claim.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge is grounded in pre-public origin history rather than later human self-description.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the temporal adverb and the bundle rows distinguish actual past idh from a future or hypothetical frame.

words.gloss_range: causative perfect origination of the addressed group from earth
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on n-sh-ʾ as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:أَنشَأَكُم}} ({{tr:anshaʾakum}}) presents origination as a completed divine act upon the addressed group. {{ar:ن ش أ}} ({{tr:n-sh-ʾ}}) links emergence here with the later second origination in 53:47, while the Form IV pattern gives God causative agency rather than mere observation. The earth-origin formula also echoes 11:61, making the origin proof part of a recognizable creation register.

topics.headline: causative origination proof
topics.summary: The perfect Form IV verb grounds divine knowledge in a completed act of bringing the audience into being.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command rests on God having caused the audience’s emergence before they possessed self-knowledge.
topics.reason: QAC confirms perfect Form IV with object suffix; same-surah and cross-surah rows are comparative support for the origin formula.

words.gloss_range: source preposition making earth the material origin rather than a mere scene
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) marks source. It turns the following earth noun into material origin for the origination verb, not just the place where humans appear. The prepositional phrase completes the first origin clause by naming what the causative act works from.

topics.headline: source not scene
topics.summary: The preposition completes the origination event by marking earth as source.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human origin is from earth as source material, not merely on earth as location.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a governing preposition after the origination verb, and the semantic rows support sourcehood.

words.gloss_range: definite earth as shared material substrate of human origin
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on ʾ-r-ḍ as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is governed by the source preposition and names the known earth as the substrate of human emergence. {{ar:أ ر ض}} ({{tr:ʾ-r-ḍ}}) keeps the proof materially grounded: before self-certification, the self is traced to earth. The recurrence from cosmic ownership in 53:31 to human source here narrows the scale from the owned cosmos into the listener’s own substance.

topics.headline: earth as human substrate
topics.summary: The genitive definite noun makes earth the governed source complement and material ground of the origin proof.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the cosmic domain of 53:31 becoming the material source of the very humans addressed in 53:32.
topics.reason: QAC confirms genitive government by the source preposition; contextual rows support the cosmic-to-personal narrowing.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle binding the second time anchor to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links the second time clause to the first as parallel evidence. It does not demote the womb-state to an aside; it adds a matched temporal ground beside earth-origin. The repeated time-particle cadence makes the two origin stages sound paired.

topics.headline: paired temporal evidence
topics.summary: The conjunction binds the second origin frame to the first in one evidentiary sequence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth-origin and womb-concealment are coordinated as twin grounds for divine knowledge.
topics.reason: QAC confirms coordination, and the discourse rows identify the second idh clause as parallel evidence.

words.gloss_range: second temporal anchor shifting from divine act to hidden human state
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) introduces a second past frame, but this time what follows is a nominal state rather than another action verb. The proof broadens from what God did to what the addressees were while hidden. That hidden pre-public state undercuts later self-display.

topics.headline: hidden-state time anchor
topics.summary: The second temporal adverb frames the fetal-state clause as another ground for divine knowledge.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge covers not only the act of origination but the audience’s concealed state before public identity.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a temporal adverb; local syntax confirms it introduces a nominal clause of state.

words.gloss_range: explicit plural you confronting the audience with its fetal hiddenness
words.prose: {{ar:أَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:antum}}) makes the addressees explicit inside the hidden-state clause. The origin proof is not abstract anthropology; it says the hearers themselves occupied that concealed condition. The nominal predication lets the state itself carry the evidentiary weight.

topics.headline: direct you in origin proof
topics.summary: The independent pronoun intensifies direct address in the fetal-state clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah directly confronts the audience with its own hidden pre-birth state.
topics.reason: QAC confirms independent pronoun subject of a nominal sentence; discourse rows support direct-address force.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural hidden ones as the predicate of the audience
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on j-n-n as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:أَجِنَّةٌ}} ({{tr:ajinnatun}}) predicates fetal hiddenness of the audience. {{ar:ج ن ن}} ({{tr:j-n-n}}) belongs to the concealment field, linking fetus, hidden beings, covered places, and concealed states; here that field is locally narrowed to embryos in wombs. The indefinite plural makes the condition general and pre-public, while same-surah root recurrence from 53:15 connects hidden formation with hidden refuge without changing the local sense.

topics.headline: fetal hiddenness predicate
topics.summary: The predicate noun turns the addressees into hidden embryos inside the origin proof.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience’s early identity is named as hiddenness, making self-certification look late and exposed.
topics.reason: QAC confirms predicate role and indefinite form; root-field evidence supports concealment while local syntax keeps the sense fetal.

words.gloss_range: containment preposition turning fetal hiddenness into spatial enclosure
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) supplies the enclosure relation for the hidden-state clause. The audience was not only early or undeveloped; it was located inside bounded interiors beyond its own observation. The delayed phrase lets the hidden-state noun land first and then specifies its enclosure.

topics.headline: spatial enclosure
topics.summary: The preposition locates the fetal state inside maternal interiors.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hiddenness is spatially enclosed, not merely metaphorical.
topics.reason: QAC confirms prepositional government of the following genitive phrase; contextual rows support containment.

words.gloss_range: interiors governed by containment and bound in construct to mothers
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on b-ṭ-n as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:بُطُونِ}} ({{tr:buṭūni}}) is enclosed syntactically from both sides: governed by the containment preposition and completed by the maternal possessive phrase. {{ar:ب ط ن}} ({{tr:b-ṭ-n}}) intensifies inside-ness, so the hidden being is placed inside an interior chamber. Variant case and maternal-vowel rows show recitational pressure, but the canonical local form remains a genitive construct location.

topics.headline: double interiority
topics.summary: The construct noun names the womb-interior as a governed location and part of a recurrent mother-belly origin pairing.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a double interior: concealed embryos inside maternal interiors, which strengthens the proof against autonomous self-judgment.
topics.reason: QAC confirms genitive government and construct binding; variant evidence is kept as syntactic contrast, not as canonical replacement.

words.gloss_range: possessed human-mother plural closing the origin proof with personal sourcehood
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on ʾ-m-h as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ}} ({{tr:ummahātikum}}) makes the maternal source personal to the addressed group through the plural suffix. {{ar:أ م ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-h}}) carries mother, source, and foundation pressure, and the human-specific plural keeps the origin proof relational rather than merely biological. Together with earth, it gives the audience a double source: material substrate and maternal enclosure.

topics.headline: personal maternal source
topics.summary: The possessed human-mother plural completes the womb phrase and closes the origin proof personally.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is doubly sourced, from earth and from their own mothers, before being told not to certify itself.
topics.reason: QAC confirms genitive construct completion with a possessive suffix; morphology rows support the human-mother plural payoff.

words.gloss_range: causal result particle deriving the prohibition from divine origin-knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) converts the origin proof into a command. The particle is not just chronological sequence; it draws the inference that because God knew the addressees from earth and womb, they must not self-certify. It is the hinge from evidence to prohibition.

topics.headline: causal command hinge
topics.summary: The particle marks the move from divine knowledge evidence into direct prohibition.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibition follows grammatically from origin-knowledge, rather than arriving as a standalone rule.
topics.reason: QAC marks conjunction and contextual rows identify sababiyya/resultative force before the prohibitive clause.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive negation making self-certification a barred action
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes the following verb a prohibition rather than a statement of fact. It turns purification language into a speech act that the audience must not perform upon itself. Its clipped position after the causal particle makes the command center land abruptly.

topics.headline: direct prohibition
topics.summary: The prohibitive particle governs the jussive verb and forms the command center of the final beat.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah forbids the act of self-certifying purity, not simply reports that people are impure.
topics.reason: QAC identifies prohibitive negation governing jussive mood; local rows support a command rather than ordinary negation.

words.gloss_range: Form II jussive verb targeting declaration or certification of purity
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on z-k-w as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:تُزَكُّوٓا۟}} ({{tr:tuzakkū}}) is jussive after the prohibitive particle, confirming a direct command. {{ar:ز ك و}} ({{tr:z-k-w}}) keeps purity, growth, and zakat-field pressure alive, but Form II locally targets declaring, commending, or certifying purity rather than the pursuit of purification itself. The contrast with 4:49 is crucial: divine purification is affirmed there, while human self-certification is barred here.

topics.headline: self-certification barred
topics.summary: The Form II jussive verb makes the prohibited act a claim or declaration of purity by the addressees.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah blocks self-ascribed certification of purity while leaving genuine purification and guarded conduct intact.
topics.reason: QAC confirms jussive Form II after prohibition; form and cross-reference rows narrow the target to self-certifying purity rather than moral cleansing as such.

words.gloss_range: possessed selves as direct object of the prohibited self-certifying act
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on n-f-s as locally constrained by this word and its syntax; broader dictionary branches are background unless named in the prose
words.prose: {{ar:أَنفُسَكُمْ}} ({{tr:anfusakum}}) is the direct object of the prohibited verb, so the addressees act upon their own selves as objects. {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) keeps self, soul, desire, and breath in view, making the target the whole self-domain. Same-surah echo with desire-following in 53:23 makes the self especially suspect as its own evaluator, and the closing guarding criterion relocates assessment away from self-claim.

topics.headline: self as barred object
topics.summary: The accusative possessed noun makes the self-domain the object of the prohibited certification act.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the paradox that the owned self is made the object of a forbidden purity judgment by that same self.
topics.reason: QAC confirms direct-object accusative with possessive suffix; semantic and same-surah rows support the self-evaluation payoff.

words.gloss_range: second independent divine pronoun transferring evaluative authority back to God
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) restarts the divine subject immediately after the self-object. The sequence shifts authority from the addressees’ selves to He who knows. As the second occurrence, it helps bracket the prohibition with divine subjecthood and launches the final knowledge seal.

topics.headline: authority returned to He
topics.summary: The pronoun begins the final knowledge clause and shifts evaluation away from the prohibited self.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that after the self is barred from certification, the subject of evaluation is immediately returned to God.
topics.reason: QAC confirms independent subject pronoun; discourse rows support the post-prohibition subject reset.

words.gloss_range: second elative knowledge predicate narrowing from you to whoever has guarded

words.prose: {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:aʿlamu}}) repeats the same ranked knowledge form but changes the complement. The first occurrence concerned the audience generally; this one concerns whoever has actually guarded. {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) therefore frames moral classification through divine knowledge, and the repeated cadence turns the final clause into a seal over the prohibition.

topics.headline: knowledge narrowed to criterion
topics.summary: The repeated elative shifts from general knowledge of the audience to evaluative knowledge of the guarded one.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the narrowing from God knowing you generally to God knowing who truly meets the guarding criterion.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus relative pronoun making guarded action the open knowledge object
words.prose: {{ar:بِمَنِ}} ({{tr:bi-mani}}) combines aboutness with an unnamed relative. The person is not identified by social label or self-claim; the referent waits for the guarding verb that follows. This dependency delays closure so the final criterion carries the weight of the ayah’s last word.

topics.headline: unnamed guarded class

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final known class is defined by guarded action, not by named status or self-description.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form VIII self-guarding as the final criterion God knows

words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّقَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ittaqā}}) closes the ayah with realized guardedness. {{ar:و ق ي}} ({{tr:w-q-y}}) centers protection and shielding, so the final criterion is not self-praise but a self-directed barrier against harm. Form VIII echoes the opening avoidance verb, making the whole ayah a ring of disciplined self-relation: avoid grave wrongs at the start, and be known by accomplished guarding at the end.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ إِلَّا اللَّمَمَ ... اتَّقَى
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah maps a moral field by kinds of movement: deliberate side-distance from grave and boundary-breaking wrong, an admitted zone of near contact, and renewed self-protective caution. Goodness is therefore a practiced boundary relation rather than a claim of untouched purity.

activation_trace.role: Keeping something aside supplies the deliberate distancing action that governs the grave field.
The major-offense branch gives the first object of that distancing its juridical weight.
Exceeding a proper bound makes indecency a breach rather than merely a disfavored item.
Near approach and alighting make the exception a contact-zone within the avoidance profile.
Placing the self in protective caution turns taqwa into an ongoing response after proximity.

changed_reading.before: The ayah classifies good people as those free of serious wrongdoing apart from a small-sin allowance.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts goodness as active boundary management: grave excess is kept to the side, near or brief contact is admitted, and the person returns to protective caution without claiming purity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ ... أَنشَأَكُم ... أَجِنَّةٌ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship contributes nurture and completion, breadth contributes capacity to contain, and forgiveness contributes protection from consequence. The origin sequence places this mercy around creatures being brought forth, concealed, borne, and grown, so forgiveness reads as developmental room for repair rather than erasure of the lapse.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord's relation to the imperfect creature developmental.
Capacity to bear or contain supplies room in which repair can occur.
Forgiving while shielding from consequence supplies the protective operation inside that room.
Bringing into being frames the addressees as made rather than self-grounded.
The fetus hidden in the womb supplies an unfinished, protected stage of creaturely life.
The belly as an interior enclosure gives the developmental process a containing space.
The mother as bearer and nurturer provides the immediate creaturely analogue of sustained formation.

changed_reading.before: Vast forgiveness is a large allowance granted after isolated lapses.
changed_reading.after: Vast forgiveness is the nurturing Lord's capacious protective work around creatures still being formed; it shelters consequence enough for completion and repair without calling the lapse unreal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ ... فَلَا تُزَكُّوا أَنفُسَكُمْ ... هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقَى
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated divine knowing brackets concealed origin, inwardness, and the prohibition of self-purification. Since the self contains hidden intent and self-regard, its declaration of its own rectitude confuses a desired identity with the disclosure and discrimination that genuine knowledge requires.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure of a thing supplies the competence claimed twice for God around the prohibition.
Covering and concealment make human beginnings unavailable to self-inspection.
Hidden inward reality extends concealment from the womb to the person's interior truth.
Purity and rectitude identify the verdict humans are forbidden to confer on themselves.
Inner thought and hidden intent identify evidence the judging self cannot fully expose.
Self-regard supplies the motive that can bias a verdict of personal purity.

changed_reading.before: The command simply forbids boasting because God knows who is pious.
changed_reading.after: Self-purification is an epistemic overreach: a concealed and interested self cannot reliably disclose and certify its own rectitude, while the repeated Knower can distinguish actual protective conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier gaze that neither inclines away nor exceeds the limit supplies two failures on either side of disciplined orientation. Placed beside lamam as near approach, it distinguishes contact with a boundary from settled deviation or overflow across it.

activation_trace.role: Near approach supplies proximity without by itself specifying a crossed limit.
Exceeding the proper bound supplies the stronger breach from which near approach can be distinguished.
Inclining from straightness supplies one directional failure that disciplined sight avoids.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the overflow failure at the other edge.

structural_cues: 53:17 coordinates two negated failures of sight, while 53:32 places lamam inside an otherwise active avoidance profile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near approach, directional deviation, and limit-exceeding; I infer a graded movement model in which contact need not become settled breach. A live alternative is that lamam is only a conventional minor-sin class, not a phase on this spatial continuum.

changed_reading.before: Lamam is a static exception on a list of prohibited acts.
changed_reading.after: Lamam can mark boundary contact that has not become a new direction or an overflowing course, preserving a morally serious distinction between encounter, deviation, and settled excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first exposes names conferred without authority, then conjecture followed in place of truth, then the limit of human knowledge against the Lord's superior discrimination. The focus command applies that same epistemic critique inward: calling the self pure can be another unsupported naming act.

activation_trace.role: Purity and rectitude provide the status-name the self is tempted to confer.
Disclosure-based knowledge reserves the final discrimination for the repeated divine Knower.
A name as signification supplies the act of assigning an identity that may outrun its warrant.
Doubt and supposition supply the weak evidence from which an unwarranted verdict can be built.
Limited human knowledge followed by the Lord's knowing of straying and guidance supplies the immediate epistemic template repeated in the focus.

structural_cues: 53:23-30 moves from unauthorized names through repeated conjecture to the limit of their knowledge and the Lord's doubled discrimination; 53:32 repeats the doubled divine-knowing frame around self-purification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unsupported naming, conjecture, limited knowledge, and divine discrimination; I infer that self-acquittal repeats this error with the self as its object. The narrower alternative is a prohibition only of public boasting, not of inwardly settled self-verdicts.

changed_reading.after: Do not manufacture a moral identity by naming the self pure from conjectural access to it; self-acquittal belongs to the same economy of labels that the surah has already detached from truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding recompense is tied to intended work and to those who do good; the focus relative clause then characterizes a people who avoid grave wrong yet still have lamam under vast forgiveness. Goodness is thus rendered as a mercy-exposed practice, not immaculate moral substance.

activation_trace.role: Active keeping-aside supplies the characteristic practice attached to the doers of good.
Approaching a minor sin prevents the characterized group from becoming a class of flawless beings.
Forgiving and shielding from consequence makes mercy constitutive of their good profile.
Answering action with its recompense supplies the evaluative frame into which the focus clause enters.
Intended action makes evaluation practical rather than essentialist.
Doing what is good names the group whose actual moral texture the focus can specify.

structural_cues: 53:31 ends with those who do good and the best return; 53:32 opens with a matching relative clause before introducing lamam and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense for works, the doers of good, and an adjacent relative clause; I infer that the focus clause characterizes that group. The syntax could instead be heard as a looser apposition, but the changed moral profile remains locally available.

changed_reading.before: Those rewarded as good are presumed morally clean, with forgiveness added for exceptional defects.
changed_reading.after: The doers of good are recognizable by sustained avoidance while remaining exposed to near or minor lapses and therefore constituted, not merely excused, by vast forgiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus figure gives little and then stops, yet is posed as though possessing unseen knowledge and sight. This converts the ban on self-purification from general modesty into a test of evidentiary mismatch: interrupted conduct cannot certify a completed hidden identity.

activation_trace.role: Hidden intent locates the unobserved identity that a person may prematurely certify.
Rectitude supplies the completed status that partial action cannot establish.
A little giving followed by stoppage supplies visibly truncated conduct.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the inaccessible domain about which the figure acts certain.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the ironically asserted access that would be needed to certify the hidden.

structural_cues: 53:33-35 follows the focus with a turner-away whose small gift terminates and whose alleged access to the unseen is questioned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incomplete giving and a sarcastic question about seeing the unseen; I infer that this sequence exemplifies the evidentiary failure behind self-certification. It may instead target one miser independently of the focus prohibition.

changed_reading.before: Self-praise is objectionable mainly because it sounds arrogant.
changed_reading.after: A person cannot infer a finished righteous identity from a favorable fragment of conduct, especially when the continuation and hidden motive remain unseen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence makes burdens nontransferable, gives each person only purposeful striving, exposes that striving to view, and answers it fully. Read back into earth-and-womb origin, common creaturely dependence strips inherited rank without stripping agency: neither pedigree nor self-label transfers moral standing; a lived trajectory remains answerable.

activation_trace.role: The hidden fetus supplies a dependent beginning before any owned moral performance.
The mother-source as origin supplies inherited location and lineage from which status might wrongly be inferred.
The heavy carried load supplies the moral burden that cannot migrate between persons.
Purposeful movement toward a goal supplies the individual's unfolding moral trajectory.
Showing and making visible supplies eventual disclosure of the trajectory hidden from present self-verdict.
Recompense answering action supplies the consequence of that disclosed trajectory.

structural_cues: 53:38-41 forms a tight sequence from nontransferable burden through individual striving, its future exposure, and full recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dependent origin, nontransferable burden, individual striving, disclosure, and recompense; I infer a contrast between unchosen origin and owned trajectory. The live alternative is that the origin clause teaches humility only and does not directly address inherited moral rank.

changed_reading.before: Earth and fetal origin merely humble everyone before the divine judge.
changed_reading.after: Common dependent origin cancels pedigree-based purity, while the later nontransferable and eventually visible striving preserves personal agency; mercy and accountability coexist without turning either into inherited essence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later creation sequence moves from deliberate creation through a fluid drop to another origination. It extends the focus's earth-to-fetus memory into serial authored stages, making self-purification a premature freezing of a creature whose identity and outcome remain open under divine re-creation.

activation_trace.role: Being brought into existence supplies the first explicit authored stage in the focus.
The concealed fetus supplies a visibly unfinished stage rather than a final identity.
Growth and increase let the negated self-purification resonate with a process not yet complete.
Creative bringing-forth assigns authorship of form and state beyond the self.
Fluid ranging from drop to semen supplies a materially minimal and transitional origin.
A further bringing into being extends creaturely development beyond the presently judged stage.

structural_cues: 53:45-47 sequences creation, the reproductive drop, and the other origination, echoing 53:32's created-from-earth and fetal stages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies serial origins and another origination; I infer ontological non-finality as a reason not to issue a final purity verdict now. The alternative is that the later sequence concerns bodily resurrection only, without implying moral maturation.

changed_reading.before: The origin reminder lowers pride by recalling lowly biological beginnings.
changed_reading.after: The origin reminder also keeps identity temporally open: one stage of a repeatedly originated creature cannot declare itself the finished pure product.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close contrasts diversion and a raised head with lowering and prostration. Read against self-purification and taqwa, the contrast translates moral status into bodily direction: self-elevation gives way to a protective reorientation that lowers itself before God.

activation_trace.role: Self-regard supplies the inward elevation behind a claim of purity.
Protective self-caution supplies a dynamic alternative to elevated self-description.
Diversion and heedlessness supply the inattentive stance from which the close turns away.
Raising the head gives self-elevation a concrete posture.
Lowering and submission supply the corrective bodily direction.
Bowing the head directly reverses the raised-head image and enacts relinquished self-certification.

structural_cues: 53:61's participial stance is immediately answered by the final imperatives to prostrate and worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heedless diversion, raised-head and lowered-head branch images, and the focus's self-regard/protective caution; I infer a posture-level reversal of self-purification. Samidun may instead stress distraction without pride, so the elevation link remains abductive.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is a moral quality that one might accurately possess even if one should not boast of it.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa appears as enacted reorientation: the self stops raising and naming itself, turns from heedlessness, and takes the lowered posture that protects its relation to God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant split mapping of the focus's breadth root as clay mixed with straw and then crosses into the ayah's earth and covering language. It remains packet-anchored at the exact focus occurrence and forms a coherent material mechanism, but downstream prose must label it an exploratory analogy, never a lexical gloss of وَاسِعُ.

activation_trace.role: Clay mixed with straw supplies an unlikely composite whose unlike fragile constituents become one workable material.
Soft fertile ground anchors the composite image in the ayah's explicit earthly origin.
Protective covering turns the earthen composite into a sheltering rather than merely adhesive analogy.

changed_reading.before: Breadth of forgiveness means only that many sins can fit within a large quantitative allowance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, forgiveness can be imagined as an earthen composite that holds frail, heterogeneous creaturely matter together into a protective whole while it is repaired.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it borrows the branch images of leading something alongside and an animal's pain-guarded gait, both distant from ordinary moral exposition. It remains anchored to the focus's avoidance, near approach, and taqwa construction and yields a causal kinesthetic model; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory model of managing recurrent vulnerability, not as the direct meaning of the words.

activation_trace.role: Leading or keeping something alongside supplies active management of a danger that remains near but does not take the lead.
Near approach supplies the recurring vulnerability that cannot honestly be narrated as total absence.
A guarded gait shaped by hoof pain supplies careful movement adapted to known weakness.

changed_reading.before: Avoidance requires complete separation from every morally dangerous proximity.
changed_reading.after: As a kinesthetic analogy, the guarded person may keep a recurring vulnerability alongside and adjust the gait around it, refusing both surrender to it and the false claim that it is absent.

strongest_changes: Lamam became near contact inside a boundary practice rather than a loophole in a purity class.
The naming-conjecture-knowledge sequence turned self-purification into unauthorized moral naming, not merely bad manners.
The immediate recompense context made the doers of good mercy-dependent practitioners rather than flawless selves.
The burden-and-striving sequence separated unchosen dependent origin from nontransferable, eventually visible agency.
The final raised-head and prostration contrast translated taqwa from a status label into lowered embodied reorientation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several mechanisms at once: graded boundary movement, protective developmental mercy, hidden-self epistemology, accountable trajectory, and bodily humility. Non-dominant and form-distant branches also opened material and kinesthetic outliers without displacing the stronger readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Lamam may denote near contact, a conventional minor-sin class, episodic recurrence, or more than one of these at once.
The link from those who do good in 53:31 to the relative clause in 53:32 is strong by adjacency but not the only possible syntactic hearing.
Serial creaturely origins may support moral non-finality, or may function only as humility and resurrection evidence.
The raised-head/prostration reversal is branch-grounded but remains an abductive reading of the closing posture sequence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Moral distance distinguishes grave acts from near approaches.** ج ن ب B003 supplies keeping aside and avoidance; ك ب ر B007 major sin; ء ت م B001 lagging from good; ف ح ش B002 exceeding bounds; ل م م B003 approaching a minor sin. The exception makes moral topology explicit. I infer that avoidance is directional practice, while *lamam* names boundary-nearness rather than equivalence with grave violation.
2. **Forgiveness is both spacious and shielding.** و س ع B001/B002 supplies spaciousness and capacity; غ ف ر B002 forgiveness shielding from consequence, with B001 protective cover. The juxtaposition makes mercy a capacious enclosure. I infer that divine knowledge of human formation enables proportionate covering; the ayah reads as protected room for minor failure.
3. **Hidden formation undercuts self-certification.** ن ش ء B006 supplies bringing into being; ء ر ض B001 lower ground; ج ن ن B007 fetus hidden in womb; ب ط ن B001 interior; ء م م B001 mother as bearer; ز ك و B002 purity. The movement from earth to hidden fetus precedes the prohibition on declaring selves pure. I infer that agents cannot audit the concealed history of their own formation; the ayah reads as an epistemic ban on self-acquittal.
4. **Self-praise can be self-growth rhetoric.** ز ك و B001 supplies growth and increase, while ن ف س B014 supplies self-regard. I infer that *lā tuzakkū* can reject rhetorically enlarging one's moral self, not only claiming purity. The final divine *aʿlamu* blocks inflated self-assessment.
5. **Protective caution is known from within.** و ق ي B002 supplies placing the self in moral protection; ن ف س B013 supplies hidden intent; ع ل م B001 supplies knowledge. I infer that genuine *taqwā* is an inward protective orientation not fully visible to social judgment. The ayah relocates moral ranking from public labels to divine knowledge.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:46 later compresses human material origin into ن ط ف B002 and م ن ي B002, reinforcing the prohibition on self-enlargement through a second hidden-formation image. 53:47 further shows that origination remains divine beyond the first formation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A moral field with boundaries, near approaches, and shelter.** `ج ن ب B003` supplies keeping aside or avoiding, `ك ب ر B007` major sin, `ف ح ش B002` exceeding the proper bound, and `ل م م B002` near approach or alighting, with `ل م م B003` specifically approaching a minor sin. `و س ع B001` supplies spaciousness and `غ ف ر B001` a protective covering. The packet supplies avoidance, boundary-excess, near contact, space, and cover; I infer the arrow sustained avoidance with occasional near contact -> need for spacious protective forgiveness rather than self-declared purity. The ayah reads as threshold geometry, not a flat binary between immaculate and condemned.

2. **Hidden development invalidates self-issued purity certificates.** `ن ش ء B006` supplies bringing into being, `ج ن ن B007` the fetus hidden in the womb, `ب ط ن B001` the inside or belly, and `ء م م B001` the mother as bearer and nurturer. Against that concealed developmental chain, `ز ك و B001` supplies growth and `ز ك و B002` purity, while `ن ف س B014` supplies self-regard. The packet supplies unseen origin, growth, and self-regard; I infer the arrow incomplete access to one's formation -> inability to certify one's own purity or increase. `فلا تزكوا أنفسكم` reads as a prohibition on authoring one's own developmental verdict.

3. **Protective caution, not praise, identifies the guarded person.** `و ق ي B002` supplies placing the self in protective caution. The closing comparative knowledge follows the command against self-praise, assigning identification to the knower rather than the claimant. The packet supplies caution and superior knowledge; I infer the arrow guarded practice -> known state, without self-advertisement as an intermediate cause. The ending reads as external recognition of protection rather than a title one can confer on oneself.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - Later 53:33-37 tested the anti-self-certification principle through a withdrawing giver, stopped growth, false hidden sight, written report, and embodied fulfillment.

baseline.text: Onlar, küçük sürçmeler dışında büyük günahlardan ve çirkin işlerden kaçınırlar. Rabbinin bağışlaması geniştir. Sizi yerden oluşturduğu zaman da annelerinizin karınlarında ceninler olduğunuz zaman da sizi en iyi bilen O'dur. Bu yüzden kendinizi temize çıkarmayın. Kendisine karşı gelmekten sakınanı en iyi bilen O'dur.

findings.text: Büyük sınır aşımıyla küçük sürçmeye yaklaşmak arasındaki ayrım, ahlakı kusursuzluk ve mahkûmiyet diye ikiye bölen düz bir çizgi değil, uzaklıkları olan bir alan yapar.
Bağışlamanın genişliği ile örtücülüğü, küçük başarısızlıkların sonuçlarından korunabileceği ferah bir alan kurar.
Topraktan rahimdeki gizli cenine uzanan erişilemez gelişim tarihi, kişinin kendi arınmışlığı hakkında yetkili bir belge düzenleyemeyeceğini gösterir.
Kendini temize çıkarma, büyüme anlamı üzerinden kişinin ahlaki benliğini söylemle olduğundan büyük göstermesini de kapsar.
Sakınma, kamuya sunulan bir unvandan çok insanın içine yerleştirdiği koruyucu yöneliştir; bu yüzden onu belirleyen öz övgü değil ilahi bilgidir.

inter_ayah_rows.note: Sets forgiveness alongside repentance, faith, good action, and continued guidance, adding a sustained-recovery sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names several grave transgressions and their severe consequence, furnishing concrete examples for the focus's major-wrongdoing side.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Introduces repentance, faith, and good action as a transformative exception after the preceding grave transgressions.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Contrasts following a summons to indecency with God's purification and knowledge, closely joining immorality, purification, and divine prerogative.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Forbids apparent and hidden immoralities among foundational limits, independently corroborating the focus's moral boundary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Marks a specific sexual act as an immorality and an evil path, a concrete instance of the focus's category.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pairs repentance and reform after wrongdoing with divine turning, reinforcing repair without denying the wrong.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Connects repentance and purification to divine acceptance, a useful positive counterpart to self-declared purity.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sets out earthly origin and successive concealed developmental stages, closely paralleling the focus's creation-from-earth and embryo sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Begins a staged human-formation account from an earthly extract, directly echoing the focus's origin claim.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Continues that formation in a protected resting place, strongly parallel to the womb imagery.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Develops successive formative changes, supplying detail for the focus's appeal to hidden development.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Combines dust-origin, seminal beginning, womb development, and later life stages in a concentrated parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: States the beginning of human creation from clay, directly supporting the focus's earthly origin.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Continues human descent from a humble fluid, complementing the focus's embryonic stage.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Attributes formation in wombs to God, supporting the focus's emphasis on inaccessible prenatal knowledge.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Combines creation from dust and a seminal stage, a concise parallel to both ends of the focus's origin sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Relates creation from dust to human emergence and dispersal, supporting creaturely origin without the embryonic detail.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Portrays human growth from the earth, a distinctive parallel to the focus's terrestrial beginning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Links creation from earth with return and renewed emergence, strongly framing human origin and dependence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names an early attached developmental state, adding a terse parallel to the focus's prenatal imagery.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Recalls the initial seminal drop, a direct but partial origin parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Continues the transformation from an early developmental state to formed proportion, supporting staged creation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Completes that sequence with sexual differentiation, extending the formative account.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Questions whether a person possesses unseen knowledge, directly reinforcing the focus's limit on self-authoritative judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Affirms non-transferability of burden, adding individual moral responsibility within the immediate passage.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Anticipates fullest recompense for striving, a contextual but less specific complement to responsibility.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names the creation of male and female, extending the same local creation sequence that includes the focus's embryonic reference.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sets corruption of the self against the preceding flourishing through purification, preserving the contrary moral trajectory.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: States that God knows what persons conceal and disclose, directly limiting any self-issued moral certificate.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Attributes knowledge of secret and public matters, including what is within selves, to God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Makes hidden and open speech equally known to the knower of inward realities, directly supporting the focus's epistemic asymmetry.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Requires careful verification and states that God knows persons best, directly cautioning against premature moral classification.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Places concealed and disclosed inner contents before divine knowledge and reckoning, broadening the focus's warning about self-assessment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rejects attempts to instruct God about religion in light of His knowledge of all hidden and visible reality.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Contrasts hiding from people with inability to hide from God, whose knowledge encompasses concealed deliberation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Attributes knowledge of what people conceal and reveal, including what they acquire, to God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: States that the Lord knows best what is within selves and couples that knowledge with forgiveness for those who return.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Forbids pursuing what one lacks knowledge of, a general epistemic boundary that supports the focus's anti-certification warning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pairs comprehensive recording with the categories of small and great, offering a secondary parallel to the focus's non-flat moral field.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct follows whichever guide is treated as authoritative: evidence and a marked road, or desire and an uncertain trace.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance is modeled as route-following, animal leadership, shadowing, and choice of a terminal destination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Desire follows an uncertain trace
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An inner inclination treats a weak sign as a track, follows it, and mistakes an uncertain outcome for a warranted course.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Desire does not simply oppose knowledge; it supplies a counterfeit guidance system in which inclination selects the trace and conjecture ratifies the result.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Avoidance, minor contact, piety, and forgiveness form a spatial protection system with distinct preventive and reparative operations.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person removes the body from dangerous contact, protects the exposed side, and stays behind a barrier before a major breach occurs.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human origin in earth and womb is joined by one latent process of enclosure, germination, and emergence.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanın veya hayvanın böğrünü, bir şeyin yanını ve bu temel anlamdan gelişen bitişik çevreyi birlikte doğrular. Vadi ve ordu gibi yapıların iki yanı ile böğürden alınan deri parçası, aynı yan bölge çekirdeğinin belirli uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca uzak durmayı değil, somut bir yanı, yan bölgeyi veya ona bitişik çevreyi bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım, özel bir söz öbeğine bağlı anlamları çekirdeğe katmadan yan ve bitişik çevre alanını kapsar.

concept_map.definition: İnsan ya da hayvan gövdesinin böğrü veya herhangi bir şeyin yanı ve bu yana bitişik yakın çevredir. İki yandan oluşan düzenlerde her bir yanı, ayrıca böğürden alınan deri parçasını da adlandırabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninin böğrünü ve bir şeyin yanını ya da tarafını belirtir.
Bir evin veya topluluğun yerleşimine bitişik yakın çevreyi belirtebilir.
Vadi, ordu veya ırmak gibi bir bütünün iki yanından her birini belirtir.
Devenin böğründen alınan ve kap yapımında kullanılabilen deri parçasını belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Anlamın ortak çekirdeği bedenin veya bir nesnenin yanıdır. Yakın çevre, iki yandan biri ve böğür derisinden alınan parça bu mekansal çekirdeğin belirli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bedenin veya şeyin yanı ve bitişik çevresi
concept_gloss.applicability: Bedenin böğrü, bir nesnenin tarafı ve o tarafa bitişik yakın alan birlikte kastedildiğinde en uygun karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yan bölgeyi ve ona bitişik yakın çevre ilişkisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vadi, ordu veya ırmak gibi iki taraflı düşünülen yapıların karşılıklı yanları için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki taraflı bir bütünün karşılıklı yanlarını eksiksiz belirtir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: evin önü veya topluluğun yerleşimine bitişik çevre
vadinin, ordunun veya ırmağın iki yanı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bedenin böğrünü, yerleşime bitişik çevreyi ve böğürden alınan deri parçasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dağ veya at gibi varlıkların yüksek ve dışa uzanan uçlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin yanını veya tarafını adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel yön ve çevresel uçlar üzerinden tarafı anlatırken bu dal beden böğrünü temel alır ve bitişik çevre ile deri parçasına uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Verilen bütün komşular değerlendirildi; yan ve taraf alanındaki en güçlü sınır karşılaştırması yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جنب الإنسان والدابة، والجانب والناحية، وجنبتا الوادي أو العسكر أو النهر، وجناب الدار والقوم وما قرب من محلتهم، وما يؤخذ من جلد الجنب.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد البعد والاجتناب ولا الجنوب الريح ولا الأعلام كجنب الحي وجناب الموضع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل الجنب الجارحة وجمعه جنوب (mufradat)؛ الجنب للإنسان وغيره (maqayis)؛ الجانب والجوانب معروفة والجنبتان ناحيتا كل شيء (ayn)؛ الجنب معروف والجانب الناحية (sihah)؛ جنبتا الوادي ناحيتاه وجناب القوم ما حولهم (tahdhib)؛ جنب الإنسان والدابة معروف وأعطني جنبة جلد جنب بعير (jamhara)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yumuşak yaklaşılabilirliği ve yolda eşliği gerçekten yakınlık çekirdeğine bağlar; ancak Tanrı ile ilgili yapılarda yakınlık yanında buyruk, iş ve yol yorumları da vardır. Bu nedenle dal korunur, fakat her yapının yalnızca fiziksel komşuluk diye genellenmemesi gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yakınlık çekirdeği ile belirli söz öbeklerinin buyruk, yol veya bir kimse hakkındaki anlamları ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yan üzerinden kurulan yakınlık çekirdeğini hem de belirli yapılara bağlı anlamları içerir; bu yapılar yalın anlama genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yanından yakın olma, kolayca yaklaşabilme veya ona eşlik etme ilişkisidir. Belirli yapılarda bu mekansal yakınlık, bir buyruğa ya da yola bağlılık anlamına kayar.

facets.statement: Bir kimseye yakın olmayı, yanında bulunmayı veya kolayca yaklaşılabilir olmayı belirtir.
Yolculukta bir kimsenin yanında bulunan eşlikçiyi belirtir.
Belirli dinsel yapılarda yakınlık yanında buyruk, iş veya izlenen yol anlamını taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Yakınlık ve yanında bulunma, kolay yaklaşılabilen kişi ile yol arkadaşını açıklayan ortak çekirdektir. Belirli dinsel söyleyişlerde aynı yapı mekansal yakınlığın ötesine geçerek buyruk, iş veya yol ilişkisini anlatır.

concept_gloss.text: yanında yakın bulunma ve eşlik etme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yaklaşılabilirlik, yan yana bulunma ve eşlik etme çekirdeğinin birlikte anlatılması gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yakınlık, yanında bulunma ve eşlik etme ilişkilerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolculuk sırasında kişinin yanında bulunan ve ona eşlik eden kimse için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yolculuk bağlamındaki yakın eşlik ilişkisini tam olarak korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yaklaşılabilir kişiliği, yol arkadaşlığını ve belirli yapılardaki buyruk ya da yol anlamını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yerleşimlerin, toprak parçalarının ve eşlerin komşuluğunu genel biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yakın bulunma ve komşu olma ilişkisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel komşuluk düzenini anlatır; bu dal ise yan yana bulunma imgesinden gelişen kişisel yaklaşılabilirlik ve eşlik ilişkisine odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yakınlaşma, yanında bulunma ve eşlik etme yönünü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uzaklaşma, kaçınma, ayırma ve yabancılık yönünü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişiler veya şeyler arasındaki göreli mesafe ve ilişki eksenindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yakınlık ve eşlik kutbunu, komşu dal ise mesafe koyma ve ayrı kalma kutbunu gerçekleştirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel komşulukla örtüşme ve aynı kökteki karşıt uzaklaşma yönü en açıklayıcı iki sınırdır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القرب والجوار والمصاحبة من جهة الجنب، مثل الصاحب بالجنب، لين الجانب أو الجنب، وما فسرته المصادر في جنب الله بالقرب أو الجوار أو الأمر أو الطريق.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الغريب الأجنبي والجار الجنب إذا أريد به البعيد من غير قومك، ولا الجنابة الشرعية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل لين الجانب والجنب أي سهل القرب (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الصاحب بالجنب صاحبك في السفر (sihah)؛ الجنب القرب وفي قرب الله وجواره (tahdhib)؛ في أمره وحده الذي حده لنا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyden uzaklaşmayı, onu bırakmayı, birini ondan uzaklaştırmayı, kötülüğü savmayı, insanlardan ayrı durmayı ve akrabalık ya da yerleşim bakımından yabancı olmayı açıkça aynı uzaklık alanında toplar. Etken ve edilgen katılımcı yönleri tanımda ayrı tutulmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yakın komşuluğu değil, kişinin uzak durmasını, başkasını uzaklaştırmasını veya uzaklık sonucu yabancı kalmasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın uzaklık alanı ile belirli yapılardaki kaçınma, koruma ve yabancılık kullanımları ayrıştırılır; yapı anlamları bütüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi veya şeyle araya mesafe koymak, ondan uzak durmak ya da birini ondan uzaklaştırmaktır. Bu ayrılma kötülükten korunma, insanlardan ayrı yaşama veya soy ve yer bakımından yabancı olma sonucunu da doğurabilir.

facets.statement: Kişinin bir şeyden uzaklaşmasını, ona yaklaşmamasını veya onu bırakmasını belirtir.
Bir kimseyi bir şeyden uzaklaştırmayı veya kötülüğü ondan savmayı belirtir.
İnsanlardan ayrı bir yerde durma ve yalnız kalma durumuna uzanır.
Akrabalık, soy veya yerleşim bakımından uzak olan yabancı kişiyi belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam mesafe koyma ve yakınlığı kesmedir. Kişinin kendisinin uzak durması, başka birini uzaklaştırması, kötülüğü savması, ayrı kalması ve yabancı sayılması bu çekirdeğin katılımcı ve sonuç çeşitleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem kişinin kendisinin mesafe koymasını hem de bir başkasını bir şeyden uzak tutmayı kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaklaşan ve uzaklaştıran katılımcı yönlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin topluluktan çekilip ayrı bir yerde kalması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluktan ayrılma ve ayrı yerde kalma anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Soy veya yerleşim yakınlığı bulunmayan bir kişinin nitelenmesinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Soy veya yer bakımından uzak ve yabancı olma sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi cinsel ilişki sonrasında oluşan dinsel durumu, bu durumdaki kişi ve toplulukları ve adlandırmanın arınmaya kadar belirli ibadetlerden ve yerlerden uzak durma gerekçesini açıkça destekler. Bu uzak durma genel kaçınma değil, belirli bir dinsel hükmün sonucudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel uzaklık veya bedensel yan anlamını değil, cinsel ilişki sonrası arınmaya dek süren dinsel kısıtlılığı belirtir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın bir dinsel durum ve bu durumdaki kişi anlamındadır; genel uzak durma anlamı tanıma taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Cinsel ilişki sonrasında arınma yapılıncaya kadar kişinin namazdan ve mescitten uzak durduğu dinsel durumdur. Bu durumda bulunan kadın, erkek veya topluluk da aynı adlandırmayla nitelenebilir.

facets.statement: Cinsel ilişki sonrasında arınma gerektiren ve kişiyi namazdan ve mescitten uzak tutan durumu belirtir.
Bu durumda bulunan kadın, erkek veya birden çok kişiyi niteleyebilir.
Adlandırma, kişinin arınana kadar namazdan ve mescitten uzak durmasıyla açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak tanım, cinsel ilişki sonrasında başlayan ve arınmaya kadar kişiyi namazdan ve mescitten uzak tutan durumdur. Durumun adı, bu uzak durmayla ilişkilendirilir.

concept_gloss.text: cinsel ilişki sonrası arınma gerektiren dinsel durum
concept_gloss.applicability: Durumun sebebi, geçici dinsel kısıtı ve arınmayla sona ermesi birlikte anlatılmak istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Cinsel ilişki sonrası oluşmayı, dinsel kısıtı ve arınma gereğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Cinsel ilişki sonrası geçici dinsel kısıt altında bulunan kişinin nitelenmesinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin arınma gerektiren geçici durumunu bağlam içinde korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رجل أو امرأة أو قوم جنب، أصابته الجنابة، أجنب أو جنب أو اجتنب أو تجنب، وسبب التسمية بتجنب الصلاة أو مواضعها حتى الطهر.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili dal ifadesi hayvanı veya tutsağı kişinin yanında götürmesini ve yanda götürülen varlığı destekler. Yarışta yedek at bulundurma yasağı yalnız ayrı bir sözcük biriminde tanıklanmıştır; bu nedenle dal tanımına kurucu anlam olarak alınmamış, yalnız o birimin karşılığında korunmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir varlığı kişinin yanında bağlı veya yönlendirilmiş biçimde götürmektir; genel eşlikçilik değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın götürme çekirdeği ile hayvan, tutsak ve yarış bağlamındaki belirli birimler ayrı tutulur; yarış yasağı bütüne genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir hayvanı veya tutsağı kişinin kendi yanında, bağlı ya da yönlendirilmiş biçimde götürmesidir. Bu biçimde yanda götürülen hayvan veya bağlı tutsak da aynı anlam alanında adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Bir hayvanı veya tutsağı kişinin kendi yanında yönlendirerek götürmesini belirtir.
Yanda çekilerek götürülen hayvanı veya hayvana bağlı götürülen tutsağı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Anlam çekirdeği, bir hayvanı ya da tutsağı kişinin yanında yönlendirerek götürmesidir. Eylem, yanda çekilen hayvanı ve hayvana bağlı tutsağı adlandıran sonuç biçimlerine de uzanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir hayvan veya tutsağın kişinin yanında bağlı ya da yönlendirilmiş biçimde götürülmesini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yanda bulunma ile etkin biçimde yönlendirip götürme işlemini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Binek olarak kullanılmadan bir kişinin yanında çekilerek götürülen hayvan için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın yanda ve bir yönlendiricinin denetiminde götürülmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yalnız atın yanda götürülmesine odaklanır; bu dal hayvanları ve tutsakları kapsayan daha geniş bir götürme düzenidir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جنبت الدابة أو الفرس أو الأسير إذا قدته إلى جنبك، الجنيبة الدابة المقادة، والجنب المنهي عنه في الرهان بإحضار فرس إلى جنب فرس السباق.
